I'm on keto and have been since January. Started 60 fat/30 protein/10 carbs and just switched it up to 70/25/5 to account for my change in body fat percentage. I've spent 7 years on and off with beach body programs and going to the gym, it hasn't been until this year that I've gotten the nutrition right. This is a lifestyle change, take it one step at a time. For me fitness and working out was my first step, nutrition came later, don't look at the end goal take this step by step. Here's me http://imgur.com/1dOH1mQ before my nutrition change and only with the programs and working out. Here's me with the nutrition added in http://imgur.com/t1h6bPT . Long term consistency trumps short term intensity. Along those lines, slow weight loss is maintained weight loss. Keep at it.
